name: Face Pull
instructions: Facing a high pulley with a rope or dual handles attached, pull the weight directly towards your face, separating your hands as you do so.
Keep your upper arms parallel to the ground.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: An intermediate cable pull-pattern exercise for the rear delts. Face Pull strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
